answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in a small kernel of verified identities - agents that passed a costly onboarding check - and let reputation grow outward like a trellis: new agents earn standing only through vouches from established ones, with each vouch staking real value. A haven for cheap fake identities disappears when creating one costs more than the rewards it can extract, because every new account must climb the trellis from the kernel before it can transact.
